messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] prod-usw2: sustained GPU queue growth > 1200 reqs/min, avg wait 9.8s, throttled requests spiking. Possible cause: spot pool preemptions + autoscaler failures. Paging oncall.
Asha (oncall): on it. joining bridge. Anyone seeing deploys?
Ruth (support): customer reports of timeouts on 'generate' endpoint — multiple support tickets from Tier-1 customers in the last 10m.
Leo (infra): I'm seeing a flurry of spot eviction events across pool-gpu-spot-usw2. eviction_rate ~ 0.37. Autoscaler logs show repeated failures to create nodes: "quotaExceeded" for GPUs in the project.
Nikhil (autoscale): confirmed. Autoscaler attempted to scale up 6 times in last 12m, each returned 403 quotaExceeded. Also some API 429s from cloud provider.
Asha (oncall): ok — immediate triage plan: 1) throttle low-priority request class 2) switch critical customers to reserved pool 3) attempt manual node launch in reserved/dedicated if available 4) notify customers and update status page. Agree?
Carla (sre): agree. I'll flip service-level routing to favor reserved/dedicated pools for routes tagged enterprise/high-priority. Small config change, should be quick.
Dan (eng-runtime): prepping routing patch now. snippet: ```json
{"route_selector": "priority>=100", "target_pool": "reserved-gpu-usw2"}
```
Asha (oncall): Ruth — can you draft an external note for affected customers: short impact, mitigation in progress, ETA ~ 30-45m.
Ruth (support): on it. Draft: "We’re observing increased request latency and errors for generation endpoints in US-WEST-2 due to GPU capacity pressure. We’re routing high-priority traffic to reserved capacity and working to bring additional capacity online. No data loss expected. Updates every 30m." Do you want that posted now?
Asha (oncall): post now. Add note about following up when we have scaling success or manual capacity added.
pagerduty-bot: Asha acknowledged incident. Handoff timer started (15:00 remaining).
Leo (infra): manual node creation against dedicated-quota succeeded for 2 x a100 (temporary). Launch command used: ```bash
gcloud compute instances create redwood-manual-aux-1 --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1 --zone=us-west2-a --project=redwood-prod
```
Nikhil (autoscale): trying to coax autoscaler to use reserved quota by setting override flag, but autoscaler throws error: "autoscaler/scale_error: pool_binding_conflict" — investigating.
Dan (eng-runtime): runtime patch applied to route selector; traffic for enterprise routes now 95% into reserved pool, error rate for those customers dropping. :thumbsup:
Carla (sre): adding a temporary admission control: new comp jobs older than 512 tokens are queue-throttled. Putting this behind a feature flag so we can revert quickly.
Asha (oncall): monitoring Q lengths. Any update on spot evictions trend?
Leo (infra): spot eviction rate has fallen slightly after provider-side reclaim events finished, but still volatile. We're seeing provider API rate limits; escalated to cloud support.
Nikhil (autoscale): autoscaler backoff now reduced polling frequency; I've force-invoked a manual scale to 4 nodes using the admin API — response: partial success, 2 nodes provisioned, 2 failed (quota). New capacity lowered avg queue to 480 requests/min but latency still elevated.
Ruth (support): posted update to status page and pinged top 10 customers in case they want to cutover to reserved endpoints now. Two customers asked for a timeline and offered to accept degraded throughput.
Asha (oncall): good. Next: if we can't get autoscaler >90% success in 30m, plan B is to start rolling canary fallback: temporarily reduce max tokens per request for non-enterprise routes to reduce GPU time per request. Carla to implement.
Carla (sre): will implement token caps via gateway config; pushing now. Example: ```yaml
- match: path.startswith('/v1/generate')
  set_header: { 'x-max-tokens': '256' }
```
Dan (eng-runtime): adding additional throttling metrics to console, tagging by customer tier so we can monitor impact in real-time.
incident-bot: oncall handoff reminder: Asha -> next oncall in 10m. Please confirm handoff notes.
Asha (oncall): handoff notes: root cause likely spot preemptions + exhausted on-demand/dedicated quota causing autoscaler failures. Mitigations in flight: route high-priority customers to reserved, manual node launches (2 successful), admission throttles and token caps for non-critical traffic. Next steps: cloud quota request + provider escalation, monitor queue and error rates.
Leo (infra): opened a quota increase request with provider — case 987654321 — marked P1. Also requested temporary GPU capacity lease from partner region as fallback.
Nikhil (autoscale): logs: ```
2026-02-12T18:21:34Z autoscaler ERROR scale_up failed: quotaExceeded for resource "nvidia-tesla-a100"
2026-02-12T18:22:01Z autoscaler INFO manual_scale partial_success: created 2/4 nodes
```
Ruth (support): status update posted. Customers appreciative of quick routing change, some still seeing intermittent 503s on non-priority endpoints.
Carla (sre): queue now 220 reqs/min after routing + manual nodes + token caps. Latency median down from 2.1s -> 0.9s for priority routes.
Dan (eng-runtime): one runtime instance reported OOM while pulling cached kvs after spike; restarted pod, no cascading failures. Log: ```
panic: runtime: out of memory
...
```
Asha (oncall): good catch. Dan — can you add auto-restart policy tweak to avoid tight restart loops during surge?
Dan (eng-runtime): done. policy set to backoff 30s -> 2m for memory OOMs.
pagerduty-bot: Asha acknowledged as responder, escalation timer updated.
incident-bot: Severity currently P1 (customer-impacting). Update when severity changes.
Asha (oncall): closing loop for now — still in mitigation but actions are working. I'll stay on until next handoff. Please file a follow-up postmortem and assign root cause + long-term fixes: autoscaler resilience to quota errors, improved regional fallback provisioning, and better spot-eviction smoothing.
Ruth (support): creating incident ticket and follow-up customer summary.
Carla (sre): will draft playbook step for immediate routing to reserved pools on quota errors.
Leo (infra): will pursue quota increases and cross-region capacity plan.
Nikhil (autoscale): will add retry/backoff for quotaExceeded vs permanent errors and add alerts when >50% scale attempts fail in 10m.
Asha (oncall): thanks team. Posting final update to channel. Marking incident as in mitigation — monitoring for 30m, then we'll reassess. :white_check_mark:"
